verses.1: And if it’s an offering of silver, we will bring it as an offering. Whether it’s brought from the morning, or whether it’s a reminder of something that happened in the past… We will bring it before Jehovah.
verses.2: And he laid his hand on the head of his offering. Then he sacrificed it as an offering to God. The sons of Aaron, the priests, poured the blood around the altar.
verses.3: And he offered as an offering to the LORD one who was a woman, with the milk that covered the altar, and all the milk that was on the altar.
verses.4: And we shall remove those two vessels, as well as the milk that is on them. We shall also remove whatever is on the tables and on the containers.
verses.5: And they burned it on the altar by the wood that was on the fire. There was a sweet smell of incense for Jehovah.
verses.6: And if from the sheep, we offer it as an offering of holiness to Jehovah, whether it be a male or female animal, we will present it as an offering.
verses.7: When he brings his sacrifice before Jehovah.
verses.8: And he placed his hand on the head of his son, and sacrificed him before the altar. Then the sons of Aaron threw his blood onto the altar around it.
verses.9: And he offered as an offering to Jehovah a female lamb, its pure and unblemished milk, as a sacrifice for guidance. He also sacrificed all the milk that covered the altar and all the milk that was on the altar itself.
verses.10: And we shall remove those two utensils, as well as the milk that is on them. We shall also remove whatever is on the tables.
verses.11: And the priest who was responsible for the sacrifice burned yeast as an offering to Jehovah.
verses.12: And if an ox is brought forward and offered before Jehovah.
verses.13: And he laid his hand on his head and sacrificed him before the altar. Then the sons of Aaron threw his blood onto the altar around it.
verses.14: And she brought her offering to Jehovah from among those offerings: milk that covered the altar, and all the milk that was on the altar.
verses.15: And we shall remove those two utensils, as well as the milk that is on them. We shall also remove whatever is on the tables.
verses.16: And the priest who offered the sacrifices burned yeast into the offerings, so that they would smell sweet. All the milk was also burned for the Lord.
verses.17: A worldwide law for your days: in all your dwellings, you shall not eat any blood or any kind of meat that contains blood.
